initial_findings.explanation: The claimed traversal capability barrier is unsupported. The existing CFG already exposes the collection, distinct current-record occurrences, loop predecessors, and typed body/exit branches. EM17 supports collection-member relations and typed empty/member guards without inventing traversal state or computing members opaquely. Omitting ir_003 unnecessarily blocks supported per-record propagation and dependent continuation.
initial_findings.suggestion: Represent ir_003 using the supported collection-member relation and typed loop guard, preserving occurrence identity and conditional member availability. Derive the finite loop scope from the existing CFG and update the dependent realization gaps.

initial_findings.explanation: The workflow-wide prohibition covers sending access_token to any recipient, but this constraint covers only notification_tool. The annotation also retains possible model observation of the acquired collection, including access_token, at a recipient boundary. That possible propagation falls outside the encoded restriction; it does not establish confirmed disclosure.
initial_findings.suggestion: Extend the prohibition to all supported recipient boundaries, including possible model observation. Preserve the actual acquisition and observation facts without inventing filtering or isolation.
